name: Align rowbly-dev with factory worker ownership rules
description:
Factory review recommendation 20 of 20.

## Context

rowbly-dev describes Story ownership and mutation in ways that conflict with factory briefs assigning all Board writes to the supervisor.

## Acceptance criteria

- Add explicit factory-worker guidance distinguishing standalone development from assigned worker execution.
- Keep Board mutations with the supervisor and have workers report the permitted command block.
- Align the In Progress Stage Prompt, brief and skill terminology so workers do not need to resolve contradictory instructions.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Supervisor accepted implementation plan. Plan accepted. Implement the bounded ownership fixes and brief rule, preserving ROW-52 baseline/push sections and ROW-63 retry section. Plan acceptance remains required in this assignment; clarify general assigned-worker behavior without removing standalone supervisor gates. Skip ROWBLY.md edits: current minimum-subagents language evaluates to zero under Assigned worker mode; report proposed replacement in final handoff for supervisor review. In Progress Stage Prompt already matches and needs no edit. Capture one agentic-tui terminal PNG of rendered changed guidance, publish orphan assets, verify HTTP 200. Run/report all four checks. Proceed.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR open: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/133. Aligned rowbly-dev with factory worker ownership: defined 'report' as a fenced rowbly block, added a brief > Stage Prompt > skill precedence order, clarified Story updates and the plan gate for assigned workers (the standalone gate is unchanged), and added an Assigned worker rule to the worker brief template. Typecheck, lint, unit and CLI checks pass. Proposed ROWBLY.md change for supervisor review: replace the rook rule 'keep sub-agents to the minimum' with 'do not spawn subagents or other threads'.
